post.title: McDonald's is secretly a landlord
post.ig:
McDonald's sells burgers. But it's also one of the biggest landlords around.

About 95% of its restaurants are run by franchisees, who pay McDonald's rent plus royalties on sales.
It owns about 56% of the land and 80% of the buildings in its main markets.
2025 franchised revenue: $16.5B, about 62% of all revenue.

Source: McDonald's 2025 annual report (10-K).
